comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 is 1 if any comment explicitly challenges an underlying assumption or premise of the OP's view, as opposed to disputing only facts or the conclusion. Feature 1 is 1 if any comment quotes or references a specific element of the OP's text, and endorsement or challenge is not required. A comment can quote OP text without challenging a premise. A comment can challenge a premise without quoting any specific text. Their null and empty-list rules also differ.
